metadata_review.naturalness_and_scope: All five notices read naturally and distinguish documented case evidence from fictional theoretical scenes. metadata_review.activation_condition: The notices and native case routes may be activated only after the independent review of all fifty same-language case editions is complete. This approval concerns the five notice texts, not independent approval of unread case manuscripts.
